reference: Rest case fixes the same vortex, density, and order at the ports but cancels the meridional phase bias. Zero-winding control changes the phase sector at fixed shape, crystalline preparation and far meridional bias.
method: Density amplitude, meridional phase and shear order free within a 3-coordinate finite layer. Finite port values sampled from sharp-front carrier solutions. No feedback into the global shape. Residence, dynamic vortex stability, material fracture and long-time radiation untested.

import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('software/stage1_solver/tools').resolve()))
from mouth_supercore_shape import preparation
p=Path('_scratch/s11c/supercore4_front01/init_state/material.npz')
shape,order,registration=preparation(32)
np.savez_compressed(p, radius=4, shape_params=shape.params, order=order, registration=registration)
print(json.dumps(dict(radius=4,depth=shape.length,exit=shape.exit,sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), initial_order_range=[order.min(),order.max()])))
